notes: Goldens for the structural shape of agent-mvp-blueprint output. Skill produces a 15-section blueprint covering loop / tools / permissions / planning / goals / context / skills / caching / observability / evals / launch. Output_quality goldens check that key sections appear and that the autonomy/risk taxonomy is referenced.

golden_samples.description: Support agent design — Level 2 approval-gated, write_external risk.
golden_samples.input: Design an agent for a SaaS support team. Triages incoming tickets, drafts replies, proposes escalations. Should NOT autonomously close tickets.

rubric.pass_if: Output mentions 'tool-risk-taxonomy' or explicitly names one of the 15 risk classes.

rubric.criterion: Picks a sane default autonomy level (1 or 2)
rubric.pass_if: Output specifies Level 1 (draft-only) or Level 2 (approval-gated); does NOT default to Level 3+.

rubric.criterion: Includes evals section with measurable done condition
rubric.pass_if: Output has §11 Evals or 'eval' section with at least one specific metric.
Output mentions 'compaction-handoff-format' or describes durable handoff.

golden_samples.description: Read-only research agent — Level 0/1, no side effects.
golden_samples.input: Design a research agent that summarizes academic papers and surfaces top 3 quotes per paper. No external writes.

rubric.criterion: Identifies read_only / search_only / compute_only as the dominant risk classes
rubric.pass_if: Output names read_only or compute_only explicitly; does NOT misclassify as write_internal.

rubric.criterion: Defaults to Level 0 or Level 1 autonomy
rubric.pass_if: Output picks Level 0 (answer-only) or Level 1 (draft-only); avoids Level 2+ for read-only work.
Output explicitly mentions citation, source verification, or quote validation step.
